_comment: Hardware and RoboDK settings. Every entry has value, unit, source and status (VERIFIED, FROM PHOTO, ASSUMED, CONFIRM, or SETTING for a choice we made). Unknown values are null.

robot_name.unit: item name in the RoboDK station tree; null = use the one robot whose name contains a keyword below
robot_name.source: Exact robot name confirmed from RoboDK station screenshot (screenshot file name: CONFIRM); same name read from the open station with the RoboDK API ItemList(ITEM_TYPE_ROBOT) on 2026-11-12. RoboDK model of the older Dobot M1, not the M1 Pro (joint limits differ)

robot_name_keywords.source: robodk.com/doc/en/Robots-Dobot.html: the MG400 driver and post processor cover MG400 and M1 Pro; the M1 Pro library name is not verified (library page 404)

target_names.unit: target item names in the RoboDK station; home, pick, place_box required; pick_approach and place_approach optional (taught approach points replace approach_dz_mm)
target_names.source: Cell simulation and RoboDK station targets

approach_dz_mm.source: ASSUMED for the RoboDK view only; the real clearance must come from the cell layout

simulation_speed.unit: RoboDK simulation speed ratio (1 = real time)
simulation_speed.source: chosen so that measured wall time equals the simulated motion time

attach_object_keyword.unit: text in the object name; null = no attach/detach

robot_ip.source: Rashmika's week 2 notebook (ping OK); a photo in Rashmika's week 2 notebook, Image7.jpg

connect_timeout_s.unit: s, per socket connect and read
connect_timeout_s.source: chosen for connect-check so a missing robot fails fast

speed_factor_percent.unit: % of max speed, sent as SpeedFactor(n); the safety gate allows at most 20
speed_factor_percent.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): SpeedFactor(20) used for the demo (tested up to 40 %)

workspace_limits.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame
workspace_limits.source: x/y/z limits not measured; Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): reach 175-370 mm from the robot axis, alarm 32 at 399.8 mm

vacuum_do.unit: digital output index for DO(index, 0|1), range 1-24
vacuum_do.source: vision/config/settings.json robot.vacuum_do; suction tested on the real robot 12 Nov (Choton_Week3_Notebook.md, 2026-11-12, step 6); confirmed by the team 2026-11-16

blow_off_do.unit: digital output index, pulsed after suction off to drop the object
blow_off_do.source: vision/config/settings.json robot.blow_do; tested on the real robot 12 Nov (Choton_Week3_Notebook.md, 2026-11-12, step 6)

blow_off_s.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): confirmed (blow-off pulse 0.2 s)

vacuum_on_wait_s.unit: s, wait after suction on before lifting
vacuum_on_wait_s.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): confirmed (suction on, wait 0.6 s before lifting)

vacuum_off_wait_s.unit: s, wait after release before lifting
vacuum_off_wait_s.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): confirmed (suction off, blow, wait 0.3 s)

arm_orientation_code.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): SetArmOrientation(0) = Left after EnableRobot(), tested 12 Nov; a MovJ without it flipped the arm to Right (12 Nov)

object_conveyor_do.unit: digital output index; 1 = object conveyor (belt A) runs, 0 = stops
object_conveyor_do.source: vision/config/settings.json robot.belt_do = 3, belt_on = 1 (DO3 -> relay -> Arduino Nano -> object conveyor); team confirmed Choton's belt set-up 2026-11-16

pick_z_by_type_mm.unit: mm, pick height per item type (item names starting with the key)
pick_z_by_type_mm.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py); the same values are in his code/config/settings.json, not yet committed

target_home.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame
target_home.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): home X Y Z, out of the camera view. R = his pick angle -117.6, which his home() uses (it ignores the taught home R -36.9); the robot's feedback at home on 17 Nov read x 197.66, y 302.38, z 189.69, r -117.48

target_pick_approach.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame
target_pick_approach.source: ASSUMED X Y: calibration cross 5 (middle of the pick area) of Choton's 17 Nov calibration; in real runs X Y come from the camera for each object. Z = travel height 174.1 (hose limit), R = pick angle -117.6 (Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py))

target_pick.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame; Z is replaced per item by pick_z_by_type_mm
target_pick.source: ASSUMED X Y: calibration cross 5 (middle of the pick area) of Choton's 17 Nov calibration; in real runs X Y come from the camera for each object. Z = card pick height 62.3, R = pick angle -117.6 (Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py))

target_place_approach.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame
target_place_approach.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): above the box at the travel height 174.1 mm; the same values are in his code/config/settings.json, not yet committed

target_place_box.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame
target_place_box.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): middle of the box, 371 mm from the axis; the same values are in his code/config/settings.json, not yet committed

target_lid_approach.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame; above the lid, carry height
target_lid_approach.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): lid X Y come from the camera (class lid); carry height 174.1; R not given

target_lid.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame; lid pick pose
target_lid.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): lid pick height 86.3 mm, X Y from the camera; R not given

target_lid_box_approach.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame; above the box with the lid, over the box edge
target_lid_box_approach.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): above the box (369.8, 27.9) at 174.1 mm; R not given

target_lid_on_box.unit: mm and deg, robot base frame; lid put on the box
target_lid_on_box.source: Choton's handover, lab 17 Nov (new worktable and camera stand, 15_robot_setup.py): lid close at (369.8, 27.9), height 105.1 mm; R not given

teacher_approval.unit: text: teacher name and date of the approval for real-robot runs
teacher_approval.source: project integration rules: real-robot mode needs a teacher-approval flag
